records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $51.9 million, or 28.3%, to $235.3 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024 as compared to $183.3 million in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The net sales increase was entirely driven by volume gains of 28.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease was partially offset by an increase in accounts receivable of $11.4 million, an increase in inventories, net of $10.0 million, an increase in prepaid expenses of $1.0 million, an increase in other current assets of $0.7 million, a decrease in accounts payable of $2.0 as a result of timing, and a decrease of current operating lease liabilities of $0.3 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses ("SG&A") were $95.7 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024, compared to $76.0 million in the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result of the factors discussed above, income from operations increased by $45.0 million to an income from operations of $6.7 million for the six months ended June 30, 2024 as compared to a loss from operations of $38.3 million for the same period in the prior year.
